description.en: RoboSPA is a large-scale robotic manipulation benchmark that evaluates Vision-Language-Action models on fine-grained spatial reasoning and long-horizon procedural planning. It includes 10 task categories and 56 base tasks, each instantiated at five difficulty levels to yield 280 variants, with 527K trajectories. Beyond binary success, it reports diagnostic metrics such as ONTA and Progress Score. Code and data are available.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing VLA benchmarks often test only simple, short-horizon tasks under predefined conditions. RoboSPA scales spatial ambiguity and procedural complexity to reveal weaknesses in current models, providing a diagnostic tool for more capable embodied agents.
